name: Klaus Oberhauser
bio: Klaus's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, refinishing vintage motorcycles in his youth. His meticulous eye and steady hand quickly garnered attention, leading to an opportunity with a local rally team. He excelled in matching complex liveries and developing innovative paint techniques to minimize weight while maximizing durability. Over the years, he's built a reputation for perfectionism and an uncanny ability to diagnose and resolve paint-related issues swiftly, making him a highly sought-after specialist. Klaus blends old-world craftsmanship with cutting-edge technology to produce world-class results under pressure. His calm demeanor and willingness to share his expertise make him a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: A sturdy man with a focused gaze and hands that betray years of skilled work.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to inspect paint finishes.
Insists on using a specific brand of imported wax for his work boots.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain concentration.
